name: Neapolitan Pizza Sauce
desc: Uncooked pizza sauce of hand-crushed San Marzano tomatoes, salt, basil, and olive oil.

source.title: Neapolitan Pizza Sauce (Italian no-cook recipe)
source.evidence: Same no-cook method from one 400 g can of whole tomatoes crushed by hand, with salt, torn basil, and 1 tbsp olive oil; it adds a little dried oregano.

ingredients.raw: 1 (400 g / 14 oz) can whole peeled tomatoes, preferably San Marzano
4 g fine sea salt (a little under 1 tsp)

steps: Empty the tomatoes into a bowl and pick out any hard cores or packed basil leaves.
Crush the tomatoes by hand or pass them through a food mill until broken down but not smooth. Do not use a blender, which aerates the sauce and turns it pale.
Stir in the salt, tear in the basil, and stir in the olive oil.
Use it raw; it cooks on the pizza. This makes enough for 4 to 5 pizzas.
tips: Cozy Italian Kitchen pours off the watery juice at the top of the can first to keep the pizza from going soggy, and lets the sauce rest 30 minutes before using.
The Clever Meal adds 1/4 tsp dried oregano.

references.title: Neapolitan Pizza Sauce (Italian no-cook recipe)
